item.description: El senador del Partido Liberal (PL) y candidato presidencial, Flávio Bolsonaro, agradeció este lunes "a Dios" y al pueblo brasileño por su victoria en las elecciones del domingo ante el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, en contra de los pronósticos. Además, celebró que el PL resultara el partido más votado en el Parlamento, con más de un tercio de los escaños del Senado. Las bolsas y la moneda nacional comenzaron la semana fortalecidas tras el resultado en las urnas. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro poised to win Brazilian presidency after shock first-round victory
item.description: Progressive voters and supporters of incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva left reeling after far-right surge Flávio Bolsonaro is in pole position to win Brazil’s presidential election, after a far-right tsunami propelled him to a shock first-round victory over the incumbent, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, leaving progressive voters reeling. The 45-year-old rightwing candidate received 56.1m votes to Lula’s 53.8m – 47.03% to 45.16% – meaning the 80-year-old leftwinger has a mountain to climb if he is to bounce back in the second round on 25 October. Never, since the return of democracy to… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

They feel that the political class is just kind of offering more of the same". The first round reveals a significant consolidation of the Brazilian right in government. item.title: Brazil presidential election: 'Bolsonaro being ahead is a surprise,' researcher says
item.description: Far-right candidate Flavio Bolsonaro has pulled off a surprise win in the first round of Brazil’s presidential election. He defied most polls to win with 47 percent, compared to 45 percent for leftist incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula de Silva. We spoke to Thomas Zicman de Barros, a research fellow at CEVIPOF, the political research centre at Sciences Po University, and columnist for our sister radio station RFI. He told us that never before in Brazilian history has a candidate who was behind in the first round then succeeded in the second. Fuente: France 24 - English.
